Planning Interiors for a 2BHK or 3BHK Apartment

Room-by-room planning tips to make a 2BHK or 3BHK feel bigger, calmer and better organised.

Home / Guides / Planning Interiors for a 2BHK or 3BHK Apartment

By the Manzil Homes design team · Visakhapatnam

Apartments in Visakhapatnam and Hyderabad are getting smarter, but space is still precious. Good planning makes a 2BHK or 3BHK feel larger and work harder.

Start with storage

Most apartments feel cramped because of clutter, not size. Plan full-height wardrobes, a shoe unit at the entrance, storage in the TV unit and a utility cabinet before choosing décor.

Living room

Plan the TV wall, seating and walkways together. Keep the space open and use lighter colours and layered lighting to make it feel bigger.

Dining

A compact dining table with a crockery unit nearby works well. In smaller homes, a fold-down or extendable table adds flexibility.

Kitchen

Use every inch, with tall units, corner solutions and organisers. See our modular kitchen guide for details.

Master bedroom

Keep it calm: a comfortable bed, a full-height wardrobe, bedside storage and soft, warm lighting.

Kids' or guest room

Plan flexible furniture: a study desk, storage beds or a sofa-cum-bed that adapts as needs change.

Work-from-home corner

A dedicated desk with good lighting, power points and a neat background helps long workdays and video calls.

Balcony

Even a small balcony can become a reading nook or a green corner with the right furniture and plants.

Decide electrical points early. Moving them after the false ceiling and joinery are done is expensive and messy.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I make a small apartment look bigger?

Use full-height storage, lighter colours, mirrors, layered lighting and furniture scaled to the room.

Should I design all rooms at once?

Planning all rooms together gives a consistent look and avoids rework, even if you execute in phases.

Do you design new apartments in gated communities?

Yes, and we plan work around society rules and timings.
